en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a heavily snow‑covered coniferous forest on a hillside. A wooden cabin or lodge stands on the right among tall trees laden with snow. Ski tracks and a skier are visible on the slope, with fencing and possibly ski equipment near the cabin. In the distance lies a broad valley with forests and open fields under an overcast sky. In the lower right corner there is small printed caption text typical of vintage postcards.
